svg.title: What VCOD checks
svg.desc: The game builds 432 bytes from the map's player slots: twelve 36-byte records, all zero except each player's type from OWNR and race from SIDE. It hashes them once with the map's VCOD table and once with the table built into the game, and refuses the map as Invalid Scenario when the two differ. The hash runs sixteen operations over every four bytes: XOR, add, subtract, XOR with seeds picked by the bytes, and rotations.
svg.text: 12 player records of 36 bytes, 432 in all, all zero but each player's type and race
byte 8: the player's type, from OWNR
Nothing else in the map is hashed:
not the terrain, units or triggers.
hash with the game's own VCOD
A VCOD is 256 numbers of 32 bits, the seeds, then 16 operation bytes. The hash starts at 0. For each 4 bytes
of the 432, read as one number w, it runs the 16 operations in order:
hash = hash XOR the seeds picked by each of w's four bytes
rotate hash left by each of w's four bytes in turn (each taken mod 32)
rotate hash right the same way
Any table passes that gives the same answer as the game's own for these 432 bytes. Every copy of VCOD is checked.
